en: The image depicts a lively outdoor scene with a natural swimming area surrounded by hills and rocky terrain. Many people are sunbathing and swimming in the blue water, and the landscape includes green hills, a rocky white cliff on the left, and scattered trees and buildings. The sky is clear with a few clouds. There is no visible modern infrastructure, and the scene has a vintage photographic quality.
